description: This file defines a utility class 'NetworkUtils' for handling network connectivity checks and listening for connectivity changes, using the 'connectivity_plus' package.

classes.name: NetworkUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods and streams for checking internet connectivity and listening for connectivity changes.

methods.name: hasInternetConnection
methods.description: Asynchronously checks whether the device has internet access by evaluating the connectivity result.

methods.name: onConnectivityChanged
methods.description: A stream that emits connectivity status changes.
